text: それとも　いまから　シッポ　まいて　かえるかい！

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins one action to the next: do this, then that. まいて　かえる = 'tuck your tail and go home'.

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい at the end is a casual, slightly teasing way for a man to ask a yes-or-no question. かえるかい = 'will you go home?'.
